title: JackFoxmc's ModPack
description: This modpack improves Minecraft’s performance and visuals. It boosts FPS, shortens loading times, and enhances stability. Shaders and improves some textures make the game look better while keeping gameplay smooth and enjoyable.
body:
# **JackFoxmc's ModPack** 

![pic](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1d796d7094b7969665fe2002ac22cc4335ebeb1.png) 
##
​
### **📌 What is this modpack**

This is a big, client-side modpack for the newer versions that focuses on performance improvements and visual enhancements. It’s designed for players who want a smoother gameplay experience with beautiful shaders, better textures, and faster load times – without affecting the base game mechanics.
##
​
### **🎯 Who is it for**

For players who play pvp, build or play smps without sacrificing compatibility with vanilla servers.
##
​ 
### **🧩 Key Features**

✅ Major FPS boost with mods like Sodium, Lithium and SodiumExtra

✅ Shader support using Iris and shader packs like Complementary Shaders

✅ Enhanced visuals with improved textures and lighting effects

✅ Optional UI improvements (e.g. BetterF3, InventoryHud, Zoom, etc.)

✅ No gameplay changes – fully compatible with vanilla multiplayer servers

✅ Runs on Fabric, offering high performance
##
​ 
### **✨ Why choose this modpack**

Unlike other big modpacks that overhaul gameplay, this pack stays true to vanilla Minecraft. It enhances performance and visuals only, making it perfect for players who want the game to look and run better – without any learning curve or gameplay tweaks.
